name: TimestampPicker
intent: A pill-shaped selector for choosing a captured timestamp. Clicking the pill opens a calendar where dates with captured data are marked with a dot (dates without data are disabled). Selecting a date reveals a scrollable list of the times captured on that day.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: entries
props.description: All available captured timestamps across every date.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown in the trigger when nothing is selected.

props.name: compact
props.description: Reduces the size of the trigger, calendar, and time list for dense layouts.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

usage: Use TimestampPicker when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

TimestampPicker should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.
